normalized.result: Both got me to my library. I'll go with Version A — the straightforward email-and-password sign-in. Since this is just my own private collection that I'll be popping into often, having to bounce out to my email, wait for a link, and come back every time I want to sign in would get tiresome fast. Typing my password and I'm straight in feels quicker and more like something I control. So Version A is my pick.
